subject: Strange error in mark-recapture data analysis

messages.author: 08cf8583b81a60b3
messages.subject: Strange error in mark-recapture data analysis
parts:
Good evening,

I have created a mark-recapture distance project that combines double platform sightings data collected over multiple years with the same platform and study area as a means to get a larger sample size to estimate perception bias. As I am not interested in using the dataset to estimate abundance I have created a fake distance column filled with "99.9", and unchecked the "Estimate abundance" options in the model design.  No matter what species I choose, I get the following error:

Error in int[p != 0] <- width - log(1 + b[p != 0] * exp(p[p != 0] * width))/p[p !=  : 

  NAs are not allowed in subscripted assignments

Calls: ddf ... pdot.dsr.integrate.logistic -> integratelogistic.analytic

Execution halted


I have checked the data for unmatched data in the object column etc. I am using Distance 7.1 and R version 3.4.3, running within Windows XP service pack 3. I do not get this error when running this analysis on the data from single years.


Any advice appreciated!     Jack Lawson
